pull_provenance.query: SELECT g.measurement_id, g.oid, g.mjd, g.ra, g.dec, g.band, z.rb, z.drb, z.magpsf, z.isdiffpos FROM alerce_tap.detection g JOIN alerce_tap.ztf_detection z ON z.measurement_id=g.measurement_id WHERE g.sid=0 AND g.mjd >= 61311.500000 AND g.mjd < 61312.500000 AND g.ra >= 25.0 AND g.ra < 35.0 AND g.dec >= 5.0 AND g.dec < 15.0
